QUOTE: `_staleness` and `_staleness_within_budget` (`tools_query.py`) size the text to fit. When the payload is large they fall back to a compact message, "stale — call status" at minimum.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the staleness notice is sized to the response budget by falling back to a shorter message, so the warning is kept and its wording is degraded.
